scoring_justification: Agent must compute dielectric quantities from the thermodynamic model. We verify a critical tunability threshold and relative ordering of dielectric constants between substrates and annealing temperatures.

hidden_assets.purpose: provide gold thresholds for scoring checks
hidden_assets.source_provenance: computed from thermodynamic model using provided equations and material parameters
hidden_assets.generation_method: gold values obtained by numerical solution of the model described in the instruction
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are derived from the physical model and are reproducible by any correct implementation

outputs.description: CSV containing computed average polarization, zero-field dielectric constant, and tunability for the specified conditions. The columns are: condition_type, substrate_TEC (optional), substrate_name (optional), annealing_temperature_C, applied_field_kV_per_cm, quantity (one of 'avg_polarization_C_per_m2', 'dielectric_constant', 'tunability_percent'), value.
